# Compiled feature matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-embed-docs.mjs; do not edit. -->

This matrix comes from the default-feature compiled capability-report example. Runtime presets can narrow enabled domains and services; core Cargo features determine which implementations are available. Named Embed features also gate facade exports: enable `mcp` or `skills` explicitly for their public setters even when core defaults compile those implementations. Embed defaults enable the named `channels` feature. See the installation guide for these separate layers.
